lines.text: The LORD says He will camp in a circle around Ariel, where David camped, and besiege her with towers.
Ariel will be brought low, and her words will be muffled out of the dust.
The LORD of Hosts will visit Ariel with thunder, earthquake, loud noise, windstorm, tempest and consuming flame of fire.
The nations that battle against Mount Sinai will be like a dream, waking still hungry like a dreaming man.
The LORD has poured out a spirit of deep sleep and shut the eyes of the kings and princes.
